title: The girl at the register, alone
logline: Gully's daughter, sixteen, at the register with the shop to herself, from the door, Gully's apron on a hook, the end stool empty, the corkboard. The page's first shop without Gully in it.

panels.composition: A small shop from its door with a sixteen-year-old girl at the register, a black rubber apron on a hook, the end stool empty, the corkboard above.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small shop seen from its door with a sixteen-year-old girl at the register, a black rubber apron hanging on a hook, an empty end stool and a crowded corkboard, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
